dsh-flykit.author: kaiomp
dsh-flykit.tagline: Fly your agents. Turn the dsh web GUI into an agent cockpit — explorer, agent terminals, model picker, usage bars, status line.
dsh-flykit.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns the dsh web GUI into an agent cockpit: an Explorer panel with a file tree, an editor that saves to disk and live file watch; an Agents tab running real PTY terminals for Claude Code, Pi, Codex or a plain shell; flykit_agent_* tools so the DSH agent can drive those terminals itself; a searchable model picker over the live OpenRouter catalog; Claude subscription usage bars; and a Claude-Code-style status line under the composer.
dsh-flykit.installNote: npm publish is coming. For now install straight from GitHub, or clone the repo and run dsh plugin --profile web add . from the checkout.
features: Explorer panel with a file tree, an editor that saves to disk, Markdown / HTML / SVG preview, and live file watch over SSE
Agents tab with real PTY terminals in the session workspace: Claude Code, Pi, Codex, or a plain shell
flykit_agent_* tools so the DSH agent can start, send to, read, wait on and stop those terminals
Searchable model picker over the live OpenRouter catalog, with favourites, recents and reasoning badges
Claude subscription usage bars — 5-hour, weekly and weekly top model — beside a Claude Code terminal
Status line under the composer: idle / thinking / running tool, turn timer, git branch and dirty count
useCases: Watching and steering several Claude Code runs from one DSH session
Editing files next to the conversation instead of switching to an editor
Harness users who want a cockpit — status, files, terminals — in the web GUI
